name: Boadicea Resources Ltd
summary: Boadicea Resources Ltd primarily explores for mineral properties in Western Australia. It explores for nickel, copper, gold, and lithium. The company's flagship property is the Symons Hill project covering an area of 75 square kilometers located within the Fraser Range Province of Western Australia. Boadicea Resources Ltd was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Malvern, Australia.
